target.statement: mIoU of 41.9 on Pascal Context (PC-59) for the Ours (CLIP R-50) model trained on COCO Panoptic

compute.basis: Training a Mask2Former-style model on COCO Panoptic (117k images) for 50k iterations with batch size 112 requires many GPU-hours; on CPU it would take days, so the target is not feasible on a normal laptop within a few hours.

blockers: No official code release for the paper's method
Requires training a large segmentation model on COCO Panoptic (117k images) for 50k iterations
Needs a GPU with at least 16GB VRAM for training
Requires downloading and preprocessing multiple large datasets (COCO, Pascal Context, etc.)
title: Global Knowledge Calibration for Fast Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
